propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy shape (any H2, length thresholds, any bullets) rather than required-section completeness, allowing padded plans to pass without Approach, Scope, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity score is duplicated in two code paths (gates.py and det_floor.py) with inconsistent maintenance, creating drift risk when extending deterministic checks.

Plan-writing guidance and G1G2/G6 criteria documentation conflict on required alternatives prose and Success Criteria handling; authoritative criteria disallow/ignore these but author guides still request them.

Proposed deterministic additions (section shape by altitude, per-AC verification coverage via operator-attested or proof clauses, placeholder-free Scope/Approach, grounded file_impact, AC hygiene, Testing markers) can be mechanically detected without semantic judgments but require unified implementation point.
